# to-stage, but A and START alternate for the whole run.
#
# The 85 s cutoff in to-stage.txt assumes the stage is up by then. When the
# title reaches the attract/promo movie later, a run sits in it: the movie is
# skipped by START, while A only walks menus. Alternating the two from the
# first second covers both without knowing which screen is up -- stage modes
# 0/1 only in the PBGL histogram means still in the front end, 4 and 6 as well
# means the stage. A tap in gameplay is an attack and a START opens the pause
# menu; both are harmless for a static capture.
